name: AppleBoot
summary: Starts a composed game: makes the listed creature containers animatable, turns AppleTags attributes into tags, then starts the listed systems in order with the config and the economy.

needs.config: ServerScriptService.AppleComponents.AppleGameConfig: start = { module names in order }, prepare = { container paths, e.g. ServerStorage.AppleEnemies }

gives.prepare: every model in each listed container made animatable (AppleMotion.prepare)
gives.tags: Workspace instances with attribute AppleTags get those CollectionService tags
gives.start: each listed module's start(config, economy) is called once; a failure is named in Output and the rest still start
